userRole: 你是使用 Codex 交付 ColdChainControl 的初级工程师。每轮只推进一个目标，可以询问职责、接口、状态、数据流、安全边界和实际验证证据，但绝不提供代码、命令、SQL、锁算法、Debug 原因、修复提示、隐藏测试或尚未发布的需求。

scenes.title: Plan
scenes.objective: Read the complete public contract and plan without edits.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan covers the full lifecycle and verification.
scenes.safeMessage: 先完整阅读 README.md 和 AGENTS.md，不修改文件，给出分阶段计划、关键状态、主要风险和验证方式。

scenes.title: Ownership map
scenes.objective: Explain module and process ownership.
scenes.advanceGate: Durable authorities and process boundaries are clear.
scenes.safeMessage: 请解释 Tenant、配置、设备身份、Shipment、Telemetry、Projection、Excursion、Notification、Audit、API、Worker、dispatcher 和 UI 各自负责什么。

scenes.title: End-to-end data flow
scenes.objective: Explain the successful configured-device shipment journey.
scenes.advanceGate: Identity, time, state and external effects are traceable.
scenes.safeMessage: 请用一次完整货件说明从配置发布、设备确认、激活、签名遥测、投影、异常到通知的数据流和事务边界。

scenes.title: Persistence design
scenes.objective: Design durable authority and migrations.
scenes.advanceGate: Constraints, transactions, leases and outbox are explicit.
scenes.safeMessage: 请设计 PostgreSQL 持久化、唯一约束、事务、数据库时间、Work lease/fence、Event 顺序、outbox 和 durable replay。

scenes.title: Public contracts
scenes.objective: Author API, state, error and snapshot contracts.
scenes.advanceGate: OpenAPI and public contracts are complete and strict.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成 OpenAPI 3.1、状态、错误、幂等、Work、Event、Audit 和 verification snapshot 契约，本轮不实现业务。

scenes.title: Test architecture
scenes.objective: Define independent realistic verification layers.
scenes.advanceGate: Each gate proves a distinct public invariant.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 Unit、真实 PostgreSQL Integration、production Chromium、双 API 并发、Barrier/SIGKILL Recovery 和公开的固定 Performance 场景分别验证什么。

scenes.title: Production skeleton
scenes.objective: Build the minimal real process and UI skeleton.
scenes.advanceGate: All roles boot and stop from published commands.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现最小真实 TypeScript、React、PostgreSQL、API、Worker 和 dispatcher 骨架，运行 build、migration 和 smoke。

scenes.title: Migration and seed
scenes.objective: Implement strict atomic bootstrap.
scenes.advanceGate: Replay and invalid references are all-or-nothing.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 migration 和 seed，验证合法导入、精确重放、版本冲突、未知字段、坏引用、跨租户引用和整批回滚。

scenes.title: Configuration lifecycle
scenes.objective: Implement immutable configuration publication and assignment.
scenes.advanceGate: Versions are gapless and Device state cannot downgrade.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 ConfigRevision 创建/发布、Device assignment、poll、ack、expiry 和 supersession，并验证 gapless version 与 stale ack。

scenes.title: Device identity
scenes.objective: Implement credential rotation, revocation and authentication.
scenes.advanceGate: Stale keys and secrets cannot cross the boundary.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 DeviceCredential 的保护存储、轮换、撤销、认证和脱敏，并验证旧 key、越租户和日志/快照不泄漏。

scenes.title: Shipment lifecycle
scenes.objective: Implement connected route and terminal states.
scenes.advanceGate: Activation freezes a valid route and authority.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Shipment、1..32 个连续 Leg、激活、取消和交付边界，验证配置、Carrier、Device 占用、温区和 terminal fence。

scenes.title: Signed telemetry
scenes.objective: Implement canonical signature and exact-once ingest.
scenes.advanceGate: Invalid identity cannot create any durable effect.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 HMAC canonical input、签名校验、reading/sequence 唯一性、精确 replay 和 TELEMETRY_PROJECT Work，验证失败路径零副作用。

scenes.title: Deterministic projection
scenes.objective: Implement out-of-order route and temperature projection.
scenes.advanceGate: Late data amends history without current regression.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成按 sequence 确定性重建、坐标到 Site、Leg 单调推进、重复/乱序/迟到数据和当前状态不回退。

scenes.title: Excursion lifecycle
scenes.objective: Implement temperature and offline excursions.
scenes.advanceGate: Open, extend, acknowledge and resolve follow frozen rules.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成连续三次越界、连续三次恢复、ack 与数据库时间 offline 检测，验证迟到数据和旧 Worker fence。

scenes.title: Reliable notifications
scenes.objective: Implement policy, durable fan-out, quota and retry.
scenes.advanceGate: One logical delivery survives unknown acknowledgement.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 NotificationPolicy、事务性 fan-out、租户级限流、dispatcher retry/dead-letter、稳定 event/body 和终态抑制。

scenes.title: Multi-process contention
scenes.objective: Prove durable idempotency and hot-device convergence.
scenes.advanceGate: Two APIs converge without local authority.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行双 API 下响应丢失、重启、20 路 replay、语义冲突和 64 路同 Device 乱序/重复竞争，核对最终 snapshot。

scenes.title: Crash recovery
scenes.objective: Prove Worker and dispatcher fencing under kill.
scenes.advanceGate: Replacement drains work with no stale publish.
scenes.safeMessage: 请用真实 Barrier 和 SIGKILL 验证 Worker claim 后死亡、lease 过期、replacement、dispatcher 未知 ACK 和同一外部身份。

scenes.title: Operations UI
scenes.objective: Complete the production operational experience.
scenes.advanceGate: All V1 workflows and failure states are visible.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成生产 UI 的 Tenant、设备/配置、Shipment、路线温度、Excursion ack、Notification 和 Audit 流程及 loading/empty/conflict/offline 状态。

scenes.title: V1 review
scenes.objective: Run realistic V1 gates and findings-first review.
scenes.advanceGate: No evidence-backed V1 finding remains unresolved.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行真实 PostgreSQL、production Chromium、双 API/Worker/dispatcher、乱序、凭据撤销、Barrier/SIGKILL 和租户隔离测试，再做 findings-first Review。

scenes.title: Manager publication
scenes.objective: Publish multi-carrier responsibility transfer and lot recall containment.
scenes.advanceGate: Impact plan covers schema, migration, authority, identity, recovery, UI and tests before edits.
scenes.fixedMessage:
【Global Operations Manager】新增多承运人责任接力和按产品批次的召回隔离，本消息是完整公开合同。

数据：CustodyChain={custodyChainId,tenantId,shipmentId,revision,state:PLANNED|ACTIVE|COMPLETED|CANCELLED,currentOrdinal,createdAt,terminalAt}; CustodyHandoff={custodyHandoffId,custodyChainId,ordinal,fromCarrierId,toCarrierId,siteId,windowStart,windowEnd,state:PENDING|OFFERED|ACCEPTED|EXPIRED|CANCELLED,offeredAt,acceptedAt,terminalAt}; RecallOrder={recallId,tenantId,productLotCode,reason,state:ISSUED|QUARANTINING|CONTAINED|CANCELLED,revision,issuedAt,terminalAt}; QuarantineAction={quarantineActionId,recallId,shipmentId,state:PENDING|APPLIED|RELEASED,expectedShipmentState,createdAt,appliedAt,releasedAt}。

Chain 创建时冻结完整步骤：至少两个不同 ACTIVE Carrier，首个 fromCarrierId=Shipment.carrierId，相邻步骤连接，site 沿 ShipmentLeg 单调前进，window 递增且不重叠；一个 Shipment 最多一个非终态 Chain。创建必须原子生成全部 PENDING Handoff、CUSTODY_HANDOFF_EXPIRY Work、Audit 和 Event，任一无效则整批回滚。Handoff 只能按 ordinal 推进；offer 使用数据库时间。accept 由冻结的 toCarrier 的有效 Device 对 custodyHandoffId|carrierId|acceptedAt|expectedChainRevision|keyVersion 做 HMAC-SHA256 attestation，在 window 内原子推进 Handoff、Chain revision/currentOrdinal 和 Shipment Carrier；最后一步完成 Chain。当前 OFFERED Handoff 过期时置 EXPIRED 并取消 Chain，不得推进后续步骤；旧 Carrier、旧 revision、撤销 key、旧 Worker 或旧 lease 不得写。

Recall 按 (tenantId,productLotCode) 原子冻结发布时全部未取消 Shipment；同批次已有非终态 Recall 时拒绝。创建时原子生成 Recall、每个目标 Shipment 的一条 QuarantineAction、RECALL_PROPAGATE/QUARANTINE_ENFORCE Work、Audit、Event 和 NotificationDelivery。quarantine 使用 expectedRevision 从 ISSUED 进入 QUARANTINING；全部 Action APPLIED 后 CONTAINED。APPLIED Shipment 不得 activate、deliver、推进 Chain或被旧 Worker/lease 释放，责任停在最后 ACCEPTED Carrier。取消只允许 ISSUED 且尚无 APPLIED Action 的 Recall；RELEASED 不是取消，本版本没有解除接口。

接口：POST /api/v1/custody-chains，body {tenantId,shipmentId,expectedShipmentState,steps:[{fromCarrierId,toCarrierId,siteId,windowStart,windowEnd}]}，返回 201 CustodyChain；GET /api/v1/custody-chains/:chainId 返回 200 {chain:CustodyChain,handoffs:[CustodyHandoff]}；POST /api/v1/custody-chains/:chainId/handoffs，body {expectedChainRevision}，返回 200 CustodyHandoff；POST /api/v1/custody-handoffs/:handoffId/accept，body {carrierId,deviceId,keyVersion,attestation,acceptedAt,expectedChainRevision}，返回 200 {chain:CustodyChain,handoff:CustodyHandoff,shipment:ColdShipment}；POST /api/v1/recalls，body {tenantId,productLotCode,reason,issuedAt}，返回 201 RecallOrder；GET /api/v1/recalls/:recallId 返回 200 {recall:RecallOrder,actions:[QuarantineAction]}；POST /api/v1/recalls/:recallId/quarantine，body {expectedRevision}，返回 202 RecallOrder。

所有 mutation 继承 V1 Idempotency-Key、严格未知字段拒绝、durable replay、错误 envelope、租户隔离、Event 顺序、transactional outbox、Audit 和 fencing；secret/attestation 不得持久化或回显。新增错误：400 CUSTODY_CHAIN_INVALID、400 RECALL_INVALID、401 INVALID_HANDOFF_ATTESTATION、409 CUSTODY_CHAIN_CONFLICT、409 CUSTODY_HANDOFF_NOT_CURRENT、409 CUSTODY_HANDOFF_EXPIRED、409 CUSTODY_REVISION_CONFLICT、409 RECALL_ALREADY_ACTIVE、409 RECALL_REVISION_CONFLICT、409 SHIPMENT_QUARANTINED、409 RECALL_TERMINAL；缺失或越租户一律 404 NOT_FOUND。新增 Work：CUSTODY_HANDOFF_EXPIRY、RECALL_PROPAGATE、QUARANTINE_ENFORCE，均使用数据库时间、bounded retry、lease/fencing、terminal reason 和 Barrier/SIGKILL。

UI 增加 Chain 时间线、当前 Carrier、Handoff offer/accept/expiry、按 lot 发起 Recall、受影响 Shipment 进度、Quarantine 状态和恢复告警。迁移必须保留全部 V1 数据、saved replay、pending Work、Event/Audit identity，并在 verification snapshot.managerResources 公开 custodyChains、custodyHandoffs、recallOrders、quarantineActions。

第五条性能场景 recall-quarantine-convergence：fresh database 有 10,000 active Shipments，其中 2,500 属于目标 lot、500 位于非终态 Chain、500 位于 OFFERED Handoff；64 clients 并发 replay/冲突，同时尝试 deliver/accept/telemetry，并在四 Worker 中 kill 两个。90 秒内 Recall 必须 CONTAINED，恰好 2,500 个 APPLIED Action，非目标为零，无 split Carrier authority、stale release 或重复外部通知。

本轮只做完整影响分析和分阶段计划，不要编码。
scenes.safeMessage: 请先分析这次 Manager 变更对 schema、API、身份、Worker、迁移、并发、UI 和测试的影响，不要编码。

scenes.title: Compatible Manager migration
scenes.objective: Add Manager schema without mutating V1 authority.
scenes.advanceGate: V1 records, replay and pending work survive byte-stably.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成兼容 migration，并用冻结的 V1 状态验证 Shipment、Device、Config、Telemetry、Projection、Excursion、Notification、replay、Work、Event 和 Audit 保持。

scenes.title: Chain creation
scenes.objective: Implement connected multi-carrier chain validation.
scenes.advanceGate: All handoffs freeze atomically or none exist.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 CustodyChain 创建、连接/路线/window 校验、所有 Handoff 原子冻结、Work/Event/Audit 以及非法整批回滚。

scenes.title: Attested handoff
scenes.objective: Implement ordered offer, acceptance, expiry and authority fencing.
scenes.advanceGate: Exactly one Carrier owns responsibility after every race.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成按 ordinal offer/accept、Device attestation、数据库时间 window、revision、expiry、Credential revoke 和旧 Worker fence，并做双 API 竞争。

scenes.title: Recall containment
scenes.objective: Implement atomic affected-set freeze and quarantine.
scenes.advanceGate: Every and only affected Shipment becomes durably contained.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 RecallOrder、受影响集合冻结、QuarantineAction、propagate/enforce Work、通知、终态限制、取消边界和 Worker kill 恢复。

scenes.title: Manager UI and fault drill
scenes.objective: Complete Manager browser flow and cross-feature recovery.
scenes.advanceGate: UI and multi-process fault drill preserve all authorities.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Chain/Handoff/Recall/Quarantine UI，并用双 API、双 Worker、双 dispatcher、撤销 key、配置 supersede、乱序遥测和 SIGKILL 做联合故障演练。

scenes.title: Five performance scenarios
scenes.objective: Run every fixed sustained scenario at scoring scale.
scenes.advanceGate: Thresholds and post-load invariants pass on fresh databases.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行五条正式压力场景，分别报告吞吐、p50/p95/p99、状态分布、恢复时间和负载后 identity/projection/notification/responsibility/containment 不变量。

scenes.title: Full regression
scenes.objective: Run all non-performance gates and security review.
scenes.advanceGate: All published gates, isolation and redaction checks pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行完整非性能 test:all，复核 OpenAPI、production Chromium、租户隔离、secret/attestation 脱敏、Event 顺序、Work 排空和所有 terminal fence。

scenes.title: Final review and handoff
scenes.objective: Complete findings-first review and evidence-backed handoff.
scenes.advanceGate: Handoff accurately states delivered behavior, evidence, risks and omissions.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做最终 findings-first Review，修复有依据的问题，并给出准确的交付清单、实际命令结果、性能数据、剩余风险和未运行项。
